name: List available account datasets
description: List available account datasets Returns all dataset types that this account can create. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets/available
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets/available
Returns all dataset types that this account can create. Each entry includes the dataset schema and timestamp field. The schema shows all possible fields for a dataset. However, not all fields may be available for your account. When creating or updating a dataset, only fields available to your account can be enabled. If you request a field that is not available, you will receive an error.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.

name: Create an account dataset
description: Create an account dataset Create a new Log Explorer dataset for the account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets
Create a new Log Explorer dataset for the account. List available account datasets to see the dataset types and fields you can use. The `fields` property is optional. If not specified, all available fields will be enabled. For dataset field definitions, see: https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/datasets/
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; body (body)

name: Delete an account dataset
description: Delete an account dataset Deletes a Log Explorer dataset for the account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets/{dataset_id}

name: Get an account dataset
description: Get an account dataset Retrieve a single Log Explorer dataset by ID for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets/{dataset_id}

name: List account datasets
description: List account datasets Returns all Log Explorer datasets configured for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets
Returns all Log Explorer datasets configured for the account. Pass `include_zones=true` to also include zone-level datasets that belong to this account. List responses omit the `fields` property; use the single-dataset endpoint to retrieve field configuration.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.
Optional: include_zones (query) — Set to true to include zone-scoped datasets belonging to this account.

name: Update an account dataset
description: Update an account dataset Updates the enabled state and/or field configuration of an account dataset. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/datasets/{dataset_id}

name: Run a log query
description: Run a log query Run a SQL query against account-level datasets. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/query/sql
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/query/sql
Run a SQL query against account-level datasets. The SQL query is passed as the `query` query parameter. Because the query appears in the URL, it is subject to gateway and proxy URL-length limits and may be recorded in access logs. This endpoint is deprecated in favour of the POST variant which sends the query in the request body.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; query (query) — SQL query to execute.

name: Run a log query
description: Run a log query Run a SQL query against account-level datasets. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/query/sql
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/explorer/query/sql
Run a SQL query against account-level datasets. Timestamp fields are RFC3339 strings. Filter with: WHERE {timestamp_field} >= now() - INTERVAL '30' DAY WHERE {timestamp_field} >= '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z' WHERE {timestamp_field} BETWEEN '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-30T23:59:59Z' List configured account datasets to see enabled account-level datasets. Zone-level datasets will not appear here. List available account datasets to inspect their schemas and timestamp fields. For more information about the datasets, and the meaning of each field, check out https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/datasets/
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; body (body)

name: Get resource change history from an account audit log entry (Version 2)
description: Get resource change history from an account audit log entry (Version 2) Returns the chronological change history for the resource identified by the given audit log entry. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/audit/{id}/history
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/logs/audit/{id}/history
Returns the chronological change history for the resource identified by the given audit log entry. The endpoint first locates the source audit log entry by `id` (using `action_time` to narrow the lookup window), derives identifying filters from that entry, and then returns matching audit logs within the `since`/`before` window. The `result_info.history_status` field indicates the quality of the resource identification used: - `exact`: Resource was identified by the resource URI. - `approximate`: Resource was identified without the resource URI. - `unavailable`: The source audit log entry did not contain enough information to identify the resource; an empty result is returned.
Required: account_id (path); id (path); action_time (query) — RFC3339 timestamp of the source audit log entry's action time. Used to narrow the source-entry lookup window. Provide the `action.time` value from the audit log identified by `id`.; since (query) — Limits the returned results to logs newer than the specified date. This can be a date string 2019-04-30 (interpreted in UTC) or an absolute timestamp that conforms to RFC3339.; before (query) — Limits the returned results to logs older than the specified date. This can be a date string 2019-04-30 (interpreted in UTC) or an absolute timestamp that conforms to RFC3339.
Optional: direction (query); limit (query); cursor (query)
